children: Armata Pharmaceuticals received FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for AP-SA02, supported by Phase 1b/2a data showing higher and earlier clinical cure rates versus placebo plus antibiotics.
FDA granted Breakthrough Therapy designation for AP-SA02 as adjunct treatment for complicated S. aureus bacteremia (MSSA and MRSA).
Designation adds to existing Fast Track and QIDP status, potentially accelerating development and review timelines.
Phase 1b/2a diSArm data: 100% of AP-SA02 patients maintained clinical response at 28 days vs 75% for placebo.
AP-SA02 dosing (IV every 6 hours for 5 days) was well tolerated with no serious adverse events attributed to the drug.
Company plans a Phase 3 superiority study in complicated SAB anticipated to start in the second half of 2026.
